prerequisites.title: Public home page and privacy policy
prerequisites.detail: The home page must be publicly accessible and describe the app. The privacy policy must be on the same domain and say how Google user data is used.

prerequisites.title: Domain you can verify
prerequisites.detail: Verify ownership of your authorized domains in Google Search Console, using an account that is an owner or editor of the project.

prerequisites.title: Organization-owned Cloud project
prerequisites.detail: For an internal app, the project must be owned by the organization and the consent screen set to Internal.

steps.title: Create Cloud project and consent screen
steps.detail: Sign in to Google Cloud Console, create the project and configure the consent screen with the app name, logo and contacts.
steps.done_when: Branding page is filled in as a draft.

steps.title: Choose narrowest scopes
steps.detail: Draft the scope list and justifications, preferring non-sensitive scopes where possible.
steps.done_when: Scope list and per-scope justifications are ready.

steps.title: Verify domains and publish branding
steps.detail: Verify domains, click Verify Branding, then Publish branding within 7 days of a compliant result.

steps.title: Record demo video
steps.detail: Record the English OAuth grant flow showing the app name and client ID in the address bar, then upload to YouTube as Unlisted.

steps.title: Submit data access verification
steps.detail: Submit via the OAuth Verification Center and answer any follow-up emails from Google's Trust & Safety team.

steps.title: Wait for Google verification
steps.detail: Sensitive scope verification typically takes 3-5 business days.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom Gmail auth config with your client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and register it in the Google client.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection succeeds.

traps.title: Apps in testing mode remain subject to a tester
traps.detail: Apps in testing mode remain subject to a tester warning screen, a user cap, and a limited refresh token lifetime.

traps.title: Testing mode caps users and expires tokens
traps.detail: Testing apps allow 100 test users, show a tester warning, and limit refresh token lifetime to 7 days.

traps.title: Restricted scopes may need a security assessment
traps.detail: If you store restricted-scope data on servers, you must go through a security assessment. Gmail read, modify, compose and metadata scopes are restricted.

traps.title: Admins can block even verified apps
traps.detail: Verification does not override Workspace admin settings; admins can mark an app Trusted, Limited or Blocked.

traps.title: Branding is locked during verification
traps.detail: Branding changes are not allowed while verification is in progress; you must cancel first.

traps.title: Compliant brand result expires in 7 days
traps.detail: If you do not publish within 7 days, you must run brand verification again.

traps.title: Consent screen shows Composio on managed app
traps.detail: With the managed app, users see 'Composio wants to access your account'.

blockers.symptom: 'This app isn't verified' warning on the consent screen
blockers.what_it_means: The app requests sensitive scopes and has not passed Google verification.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a verification request; during development you can continue via Advanced > Go to project (unsafe).
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft scope justifications and a demo script.

blockers.symptom: A customer's users cannot authorize the app
blockers.what_it_means: Their Workspace administrator may have blocked or limited the app.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the customer's admin to mark your OAuth client as Trusted.
